D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the Youth and Adult
Scholarship Program is currently active, the application deadline is February 13; and provided an
update on the parade and carnival anniversary.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, highlighted some of the new laws taking effect in 2026.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided updates on the SCAG STBG Street Rehabilitation
project, LA County Sanitation District Sewer Relining Project, and Public Facility Renovation Projects.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided updates on the SELACO “Youth@Work” program, and
ERP project.
